page.layout: One page of verse in one column, set in italic with a running head "SYLVÆ." at the top. A small mark at the top right corner. A signature "A" at the foot. No marginal notes.

p.i: Commoda nunc referam toties concessa Iacobi
Vos meministis enim regis contusa superbi
Pectora, Vos medio gradientes aequore turmas,
Deletasque acies scitis, partosque triumphos.
Scitis vt in terras summo descendere caelo
Sustinui, vt leges illis & iura tuenda
Sancirem vitae: nostri quoque testis amoris
Sol erit, assueto petitus descendere cursu:
Et scissa Iordanis aqua, sonitúque tubarum
Capta vrbes, pulsique sua ditione tyranni.
Haec illis igitur tribui: quid maxima vero
Tot bona commemorem Iessao praestita vatì
Illi ego pastori memini tribuisse coronam,
Ereptoque pedo sceptum donasse ferendum:
Quinetiam Sasto memini eripuisse giganti:
Quúmque graves vrgere minas odiúmque Saulis
Sensissem, tutum ipse dedi (miseratus egentis)
Exilium, & placida florentia regna quiete.
Nunc tamen antiquos mores imitatus auorum,
Oblitúsque mei, nec caeli spernere legis,
Nec sceleus infandum sceleri iunxisse veretur.
Hinc leges, hinc iura tacent violata sacrati
Coniugi, hinc nostrae non digna morte peremptus
Vindictam petit Vrias. nunc ergo superbum
Vlcisci regis pectus, populúmque ferocem
Delebo iratus, nostri monimenta doloris.
Desierat, toto exoritur quum murmur olympo.
Protinus at mæsto affurgens Clementia vultu,
Conqueritur lacrymas, nec enim si plectere digni

page.notes: Top-right corner has a small mark. The line "Scitis vt in terras" and several other lines are printed with long s and ligatures, rendered as plain s; the initial letters of several lines are decorated capitals. The last line is at the foot of the page before the signature A. Some words are doubtful due to the italic type and show-through.
